(4) Where any of the following documents, that is to say—
(a) a notice under section 11(1) or section 15(6) of this Act; or
(b) a copy of a direction given under section 12(2), section 13(1) or (2) or
section 16(3) of this Act,
is served by sending it by registered post or by the recorded delivery service, service
thereof shall be deemed to have been effected at the time when the letter containing
it would be delivered in the ordinary course of post; and so much of [F68section 7 of
the M9Interpretation Act 1978] as relates to the time when service by post is deemed to
have been effected shall not apply to such a document if it is served by so sending it.
